scope: Installed Lua call forms and UI lifecycle only; no game classes executed or copied
observations: MainScreen registers LoadMainScreenPanel at OnMainMenuEnter; root instance distinguishes inGame and exposes UI/focus methods.
ISUIElement instantiation creates children; ISPanelJoypad supplies focus rows, combo/button and text-entry controller dispatch.
CharacterCreationMain calls getFileReader(filename,true), readLine and close, then getFileWriter(filename,true,false), write and close. CoopOptionsScreen also calls getFileReader(filename,false).
No atomic replace/durable flush guarantee is established for native file writers. Alternating checksummed checkpoints retain a previous valid local draft library.
MORTIS creator chains MainScreen methods rather than replacing vanilla source, registers presentation lifecycle handlers only, and has no network/assignment/spawn route.
